title: 第一卷 第17章 她不要和这个魔鬼大师兄在一起第一卷 第18章 刚出谢寒声的狼窝又入沈长安的虎穴
slug: 笨蛋美人当团宠师兄们抢疯了
content_zh:
;;
清风阁呈现出诡异的气氛。
谢寒声根本不知从何说起。
说他冒犯了师妹？
他还没有禀明师尊，提前说出口难免影响师妹的清誉。
室内迎来长久的沉默。
沈长安柔和的眼眸微眯。
向来成熟稳重，最不让人操心的二师弟，竟然学会和他说谎了。
沈长安面上的笑容越来越冷，玉色的手指轻轻点了点太阳穴的位置，“唔，让我猜猜。”
“小师妹修为低，体质弱，比不得你这位金丹期修士。”
“你说师妹中了魔气，回来后师妹筋脉只是略有损伤，她的修为不可能拖到回宗门，而你又身中魔气。”
“你以前不喜和人往来，醒来后，不仅主动找小师妹，还同意教她练剑……”
“除非，发生了什么，让你们的关系发生变化……”
主动接近不喜欢的人，有几种情况，是迫不得已还是心有愧疚？
“你不会医术，如何帮的师妹？”
他早该想到的……
师妹绝对不是吃亏的人，吃了大亏肯定要报复回去的。
应该还没到那种不可控制的程度。
沈长安抬了抬眼眸，浅色的瞳仁在光线下仿佛闪着光，唇瓣勾起一个泛着凉意的弧度，“二师弟，犯了错误就要接受惩罚，你也不例外。”
沈长安是一个遵守规则的人，也注重规则，曾经有弟子猜测，如果宗主顾衍做错了什么事，大师兄是不是也会抄家伙跟他师尊理论个一二？

他不喜欢有人挑衅规则。
他的每一句话，都点到为止，剩下的无端让人遐想。
舒晩昭和谢寒声的脸色随之一变。
舒晩昭是害怕沈长安这个人精。
谢寒声是害怕坏了师妹的名声。
好在他知道大师兄不是不明事理的人，他嗓音低沉，和大师兄坦白，“是我轻薄了师妹，原本打算等师尊出关，求娶师妹的。”
“你猜师尊会不会打断你的腿？”沈长安温柔浅笑，“师尊修无情道，最讨厌的便是情爱二字，且不说师妹年龄尚小不懂事，就说你早早结下道侣，可还会一心修炼？”
沈长安和他们不同，他更了解他们的师尊。
那是一个被无情道架起，一心想飞升的人。
他最忌讳爱情。
一旦被师尊发现，整个宗门都鸡犬不宁，他绝对不允许这件事发生。
“二师弟，话已至此，你自行去领罚吧，至于师妹……”沈长安瞥一眼那个闯祸精，“还小，接下里就由我代师尊管教她。”
舒晩昭被他瞥得头皮发麻，凭借本能想要躲到谢寒声身后。
男人躬身行礼，“师弟在来之前已经和小师妹道过歉，即便师兄不说，也会去领罚。”
他起身，将舒晩昭护在身后，疏朗矫健的身影将她遮挡，固执地和沈长安对视，眼里是不容忽视的执拗：“无论如何，我都会和师尊禀明一切。”
这一刻，坐在他们面前的沈长安，反倒被衬托得像棒打鸳鸯的恶人。
沈长安气笑了。
师尊有四名亲传弟子。
三师妹是唯一一名女弟子，整天嚣张跋扈到处惹祸。

;;
Qingfeng Pavilion presented a strange atmosphere.
Xie Hansheng didn't know where to start.
Say he offended junior sister?
He has not yet informed his master, so telling him in advance will inevitably affect his junior sister's reputation.
There was a long silence in the room.
Shen Changan's soft eyes narrowed slightly.
The second junior brother who was always mature and stable and the least worried about him actually learned to lie to him.
The smile on Shen Changan's face became colder and colder, and his jade-colored fingers gently tapped his temples, "Well, let me guess."
"My junior sister has low cultivation level and weak constitution. She is not as good as you, a golden elixir stage monk."
"You said that Junior Sister was possessed by demonic energy. When she came back, Junior Sister's tendons and veins were only slightly damaged. Her cultivation level cannot be delayed until she returns to the sect, and you are possessed by demonic energy."
"You didn't like to interact with others before. After you woke up, you not only took the initiative to find your junior sister, but also agreed to teach her how to practice swordsmanship..."
"Unless something happens that changes your relationship..."
What are some situations in which you take the initiative to approach someone you don't like? Is it out of necessity or out of guilt?
"You don't have medical skills, how can you help junior sister?"
He should have thought of it earlier...
Junior sister is definitely not the one who suffers a loss. She will definitely take revenge after suffering a big loss.
It shouldn't be that uncontrollable yet.
Shen Changan raised his eyes, his light-colored pupils seemed to sparkle in the light, and his lips curved in a cool arc, "Second junior brother, if you make a mistake, you will be punished, and you are no exception."
Shen Changan is a person who abides by the rules and pays attention to them. Some disciples once speculated that if the sect leader Gu Yan did something wrong, would the senior brother also cheat and argue with his master?
He doesn't like when people challenge the rules.
Every word he says is on point, and the rest is unreasonable and makes people daydream about it.
The expressions of Shu Mingzhao and Xie Hansheng changed accordingly.
Shu Mingzhao was afraid of Shen Changan.
Xie Hansheng was afraid of ruining his junior sister's reputation.
Fortunately, he knew that the senior brother was not an unreasonable person. He confessed to the senior brother in a low voice, "I was the one who was scornful of the junior sister. I originally planned to wait for the master to come out of seclusion and ask to marry the junior sister."
"Do you think Master will break your legs?" Shen Chang'an smiled softly, "Master practices the ruthless Tao, and what he hates the most is the word love. Not to mention that Junior Sister is still young and ignorant, but you have made a Taoist companion early, but you still practice wholeheartedly?"
Shen Changan is different from them, he understands their master better.
That was a person who was set up by the ruthless way and wanted to ascend.
He is most taboo about love.
Once discovered by the Master, the entire sect would be restless, and he would never allow this to happen.
"Second Junior Brother, that's it. You can go and receive the punishment on your own. As for Junior Sister..." Shen Changan glanced at the troublemaker, "She is still young, so I will discipline her on behalf of Master from now on."
Shu Mingzhao was so stunned by his glance that he instinctively wanted to hide behind Xie Hansheng.
The man bowed and saluted, "Junior Brother has already apologized to Junior Sister before coming here. Even if Senior Brother doesn't say anything, he will go and receive the punishment."
He stood up, protected Shu Minzhao behind him, and shielded her with his sparse and strong figure. He looked at Shen Changan stubbornly, with a stubbornness that could not be ignored in his eyes: "No matter what, I will tell everything to Master."
At this moment, Shen Changan, who was sitting in front of them, was made to look like a villain beating a mandarin duck.
Shen Changan laughed angrily.
The master has four direct disciples.
The third junior sister is the only female disciple, and she is arrogant and domineering all day long, causing trouble everywhere.
